verdict.rationale: Ghostty has no OpenAPI or swagger spec: all candidate paths return 404, as do llms.txt and docs.md, and the runtime probe found no remote-control or IPC interface. The closest machine-readable equivalent is the built-in AppleScript dictionary describing windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events, plus the `+list-actions` enumeration of bindable actions. Neither is evidenced as a downloadable, standalone spec. missing for 10: a downloadable machine-readable spec file, cross-platform coverage beyond the macOS-only AppleScript dictionary, documentation of the spec's schema or format, independent corroboration.
